title: randia spinosa
intro: Randia spinosa, commonly known as the "Yellow Bird Plum," is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is a woody evergreen shrub or small tree, native to tropical Asia, particularly in India and Southeast Asia. Randia spinosa has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, inflammation, and gastrointestinal issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
